name: Hexciri Settings
author: Khalid Alhazmi
description: Hexciri Settings, like System Settings on a Mac: Wi-Fi, sound, displays, keyboard, appearance, the bar, the Hexciri menu, and more, without editing config files. Forked from ipkalid/omarchy-settings, shipped as a Hexciri shell plugin (service kind): enabling it builds the app, no bar widget.
